algorithms/dynamic-pricing.title: Dynamic Pricing Engine
algorithms/dynamic-pricing.description: The pricing engine calculates a fair, real-time price for every energy trade. It replaces arbitrary utility tariffs with a multi-factor model driven by actual market conditions. The coefficients can be adjusted by community governance.

algorithms/matching-engine.title: Matching Engine
algorithms/matching-engine.description: The matching engine runs as a background goroutine that polls for compatible buy and sell orders every 5 seconds. When a match is found, it sequences through price calculation, ZK verification, database settlement, IoT notification, and Soroban execution — all within a single atomic transaction.

algorithms/zero-knowledge.title: Zero-Knowledge Proofs
algorithms/zero-knowledge.description: Sellers prove they have sufficient battery capacity to fulfill an order — without revealing the exact battery percentage. The matching engine verifies this claim before executing any trade.

api/api-overview.title: API Reference
api/api-overview.description: The Stelltron backend exposes a REST API built on Go/Gin. All protected endpoints require a Bearer JWT token in the Authorization header.

architecture/business-flow.title: Business Flow
architecture/business-flow.description: A complete walkthrough of the Stelltron business model — from solar production to settled trade to revenue distribution.

architecture/system-overview.title: System Architecture
architecture/system-overview.description: Stelltron is a full-stack application spanning physical hardware, an IoT communication layer, a Go backend, a Next.js frontend, and four Soroban smart contracts on Stellar. Every layer has a defined contract with the layers above and below it.

contracts/contracts-overview.title: Smart Contracts
contracts/contracts-overview.description: Stelltron deploys four Soroban contracts on the Stellar testnet, written in Rust and compiled to WASM. All contracts are under 200 lines each, intentionally lean — on-chain storage is expensive, so the Soroban contracts handle token accounting and governance, while the Go backend handles order books and matching logic.

defi/defi-overview.title: DeFi Protocol
defi/defi-overview.description: Stelltron builds a DeFi layer on top of physical energy trading. Participants earn yield by providing liquidity, borrowing tokens for arbitrage, and capturing trade commissions.

getting-started/quickstart.title: Getting Started
getting-started/quickstart.description: This guide walks through running the full Stelltron stack locally: smart contracts on Stellar testnet, Go backend, and Next.js frontend.

intro.title: Stelltron
intro.description: Peer-to-peer solar energy trading on the Stellar blockchain.

iot/iot-overview.title: IoT Layer
iot/iot-overview.description: The physical layer consists of ESP32 microcontrollers managing actual battery-to-battery energy transfer, orchestrated by a Raspberry Pi 4B acting as a local edge gateway. The Pi handles bidirectional communication between the hardware relay circuit and the cloud backend.
